explication: NGINX Ingress Controller watches Kubernetes routing resources and turns them into NGINX load-balancer configuration. Users configure standard Ingress, VirtualServer/VirtualServerRoute, and TransportServer resources; the controller reconciles changes, generates configuration, and applies it through the NGINX manager. Additional branches cover certificate management, external DNS, App Protect security, and telemetry. The README documents product capabilities; source excerpts are partial, so some orchestration links are shown as unverified rather than asserted as direct calls.
